_note: No free API provides live, naked-eye comet ephemerides. This list is curated manually — update it a few times a year from sources like theskylive.com/comets or the British Astronomical Association's comet section. Most nights, nothing here will be naked-eye visible; that absence is itself accurate information, not a gap in the app.
